Hoplyra 1.3.2 — desktop builds

Linux (x86_64 AppImage)
  chmod +x Hoplyra-1.3.2-x86_64.AppImage
  ./Hoplyra-1.3.2-x86_64.AppImage

  Requires 64-bit Linux, glibc 2.35+ (Ubuntu 22.04+, Debian 12+).
  Install libfuse2 on Ubuntu/Debian if AppImage won't start.
  Fallback: ./Hoplyra-1.3.2-x86_64.AppImage --appimage-extract-and-run

Windows (x64 portable)
  Run: Hoplyra-1.3.2-x64-portable.exe

  Data: %APPDATA%\hoplyra-desktop\hoplyra-data\

Default login: admin / admin

See SHA256SUMS for checksums.
